description: Structured logging (structlog), Sentry integration, and Prometheus metrics. Replaces print/logging with structlog JSON formatting. Adds sentry-sdk with SENTRY_DSN env var. Creates monitoring/ module with prometheus_client counters/histograms and /metrics endpoint.
steps: Add structlog, sentry-sdk, prometheus-client to requirements.txt

Create logging_config.py at project root: configure structlog with JSON formatting for prod, colored console for dev. Add get_logger(name) helper. Detect mode from LOG_FORMAT env var (json/console, default console)
Add SENTRY_DSN and LOG_FORMAT to config.py (from env vars, SENTRY_DSN defaults to empty string meaning disabled)

Create sentry_setup.py at project root: init_sentry() function that initializes sentry_sdk if SENTRY_DSN is set. Configure traces_sample_rate=0.1, attach_stacktrace=True. Add breadcrumb helpers for payments and trades

Create monitoring/metrics.py: define prometheus_client metrics - Counter for http_requests_total (labels: method, path, status), payment_events_total (labels: event_type), trade_operations_total (labels: symbol, side, outcome). Histogram for http_request_duration_seconds, trade_pnl_distribution. Gauge for queue_length, open_positions_count
Create monitoring/middleware.py: aiohttp middleware that increments http_requests_total and observes http_request_duration_seconds for each request
Create monitoring/endpoint.py: function to add /metrics route to aiohttp app that serves prometheus_client.generate_latest()
Create monitoring/grafana_dashboard.json: example Grafana dashboard JSON with panels for request rate, payment events, trade PnL, open positions
Update main.py imports: add structlog logger initialization at top (from logging_config import get_logger), call init_sentry() after config validation
Replace print() calls in payments/service.py with structlog logger (log.info, log.error with structured context)
Replace logging.getLogger in freelance_automation/kwork.py, freelance_automation/flru.py, freelance_automation/scheduler.py with structlog (from logging_config import get_logger)
Replace print() in viral/telegram_handlers.py with structlog
Replace print() in ad_testing/engine.py with structlog

Create tests/test_logging_and_monitoring.py: test structlog configuration produces valid output, test prometheus metrics increment correctly, test /metrics endpoint returns text/plain with expected metric names, test sentry_setup does not crash when DSN is empty
acceptance_criteria: structlog configured in logging_config.py with JSON and console modes
sentry_setup.py initializes SDK when SENTRY_DSN is set, does nothing when empty
monitoring/ module with metrics.py, middleware.py, endpoint.py exists
Key modules (payments/service.py, freelance_automation/*.py, viral/, ad_testing/) use structlog instead of print/logging
ruff check passes on all new/modified files
verification: python -c "import logging_config; import sentry_setup; from monitoring import metrics, middleware, endpoint"
